paite: Himahleh unaute aw, i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong paina leh amah tuak ding a i kikhopna ding thu ah;
heading: Puksanna
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

paite: Toupa ni atung khinta chihna kha in hiam aw, thu ziak in hiam aw, kou a kipan a laikhak ziak in hiam aw, na lungsim uh alin pahlouhna ding in leh na buailouhna ding un ka hon ngen uhi.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

paite: Kuamah in bangmah in hon khem kei uhen; puksanna tak ahong tun masak phot a, khelhna mipa, mangthang tapa ngei ahong kilat keileh huai ni tung lou ding ahi.
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

paite: Ama'n Pathian kichi peuhmahte leh biak a om peuhmahte kalh in, amah leh amah kitawisang in Pathian tempul ah atu dia, Pathian in amah leh amah akibawl ding hi.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

paite: Na lak ua ka om lai in leng huai bang thu ka hon hilh zel chih na theigige kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

paite: Amah hun tuam a ahong kilattheihna ding in bang in kham ahia chih na thei uhi.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

paite: Dan lou a omna thuguk in tu in leng asem lellel ngal a, himahleh lakmang a a-om masiah tua akhampa'n huchibang in akham ding hi.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

paite: Huai lakmang ahih chiang in dan a talekpa ahong kilangta ding a, Toupa Jesu'n akam hatna in athat dia, ahong paina leh kilakna in ahihmang ding hi.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

paite: Huai dan a talekpa ahong paina Setan sepdan bang zel in, thilhihtheihna chiteng, chiamtehna chiteng, zuau thillamdang chiteng toh,
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

paite: mangthang lelte ding in khemna gilou chiteng toh ahi ding; hotdam a a-omtheihna ding ua thutak itna apom louh ziak un.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

paite: Huaiziak in zuauthu agintakna ding un, Pathian in diklouhna nasep akiang uah ahon sawl ding hi;
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

paite: thutak gingta lou a diktatlouhna a kipakzawte'n siam louh atan vek theihna ding un.
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

paite: Unau Toupa ngaihtakte aw, Kha hihsiangthou leh thutak gingta a hotdam a om ding in atung a kipan Pathian in nou ahon tel ziak in na tungthu uah zaw Pathian kiang ah kipahthu gen zel ding him ka hi uhi.
heading: Dingkip Ding A Thuhilhna
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

paite: Huchibang ding in ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist thupina tang ding in ka tanchinhoih un nou ahon sam hi.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, dingkip unla, kam a ka thugen uleh laikhakte a nou ka hon sinsakte uh lenkip un.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

paite: Huchi in i Toupa Jesu Khrist mahmah leh Pathian i Pa, eite hon itpa leh hehpihna ziak a tangtawn a khamuanna leh lametna hoih hon pepa'n,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

paite: na lungtangte uh hihkhamuang in, thil hoih hih leh thugen chiteng ah hon hihkip hen.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
